notes: Fresh 2026-10-01 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of the complete 154-candidate/154-review pool. Applied entity-accuracy hard rejects, all five component thresholds, judge_score >=58 and semantic deduplication. Rejected accidental ticker/common-word mappings, evergreen/SEO commentary, generic predictions, weak evidence and duplicate Paramount-WBD, Micron, Bitcoin and rates angles. Selected 17 distinct eligible events rather than padding to 20. Evidence arrays preserve the supplied judge-review evidence samples used for semantic judging; no direct YouTube calls were made.
